guard: the spear shaft behind the gripping hand and the leg edge is inferred (nearest shaft colours per 2px cell) and always hidden under upper/legs at rest.

guard: the plate behind the figure (house wall, hedge, fence rail and grass continuation) is exemplar-copied from same-image donor windows (hedge, wall, fence rail, grass; rectangles in provenance); it is only visible where the spear or the breathing upper vacates pixels.
guard: blink eyelids are authored (sampled local skin tone + 2px dark lid line aligned to each eye).

farmer: matte traced along the outermost dark outline pixels of hat, hair, overalls, fists and boots (1 px generous, peeled back onto the outline by local luma evidence); crops and soil stay background.
farmer: the torso side under the screen-right arm is inferred (left torso edge mirrored about x=314 below the shoulder, nearest torso colours in the shoulder seam) and hidden under the arm at rest.
farmer: the plate behind the figure (soil, crop leaves) is exemplar-copied from same-image donor windows within a 26px ring.
farmer: blink eyelids are authored (sampled local skin tone + 2px dark lid line aligned to each eye).

merchant: neck/hair support under the head is a copy of the head's rows 497-503 stored in the body texture and hidden under the head at rest.

merchant: the plate behind her (stall interior, awning edge above the hair) is exemplar-copied from same-image donor windows beside her; the market host hole excludes the counter and goods in front of her.
merchant: blink eyelids are authored (sampled local skin tone + 2px dark lid line aligned to each eye).
dog: matte traced along the outermost dark outline pixels of head, ears, body, paws and curled tail; the dark ground shadow under the paws stays background.

dog: body support behind the head (neck/chest fur) and the rump under the tail base are inferred from the nearest body fur per 2px cell; the rump gets a 2px outline in the dog's own outline colour; both are hidden under head/tail at rest.
dog: the plate behind the dog (dirt path above y~525, grass and ground shadow below) is exemplar-copied from same-image donor windows on each side of the path/grass boundary.
dog: the blink eyelid is authored (sampled fur tone + 2px dark lid line aligned to the visible eye).

Blacksmith: matte = native-pixel contour along his outermost outline (head loop peeled against the light wall at luma >= 80 with a 1px anti-alias fringe kept, body hand-traced); 5311 px split into legs (belt down incl. the right knee), upper (head, torso, screen-right arm, apron pouch) and arm (screen-left arm: shoulder, forearm, fist and the small tool in the hand).

Blacksmith upper carries 111 inferred px under the arm footprint: the torso's left edge (mirror of the adjacent vest columns plus a source-outline column), the jaw corner and a shoulder cap centred on the arm pivot (1312, 823), so the raised arm reveals a body, never background.

Blacksmith hammer is authored pixel art (392 px, 2px art cells inside a 1px outline): 10x12 iron head with a light top/left highlight (greys sampled from the anvil face), 6px wooden handle (browns sampled from the wooden post); the observed fist pixels are copied over the handle so the hand wraps it. Grip pivot (1299, 835); at rest the head stands on the anvil top face, impact (1263, 840); arm rotation 0..1.8 rad lifts the head above his hair.
Blacksmith blink is an authored eyes-closed overlay (104 px): cheek skin continued up over the eyes plus two lid arcs in the source eye-outline colour.

Blacksmith plate: 5311 matte px are inferred wall/anvil/stone-course/floor continuation made by mirror-copying same-image pixels within 14px of the matte (2px outline halo skipped, horizontal bands only below y=818; the arm footprint tiles the anvil face columns x1274..1287). Outside the matte the plate is the reference.
Blacksmith host hole: 222 smith.png pixels (hair top rows and the tool tip lie outside the layer's actor rectangle hole) are cleared so the animated body is not duplicated.

Boat: hull matte of 10103 px follows the dark outline (rim, cargo and keel included): the loose contour is peeled against water/foam (b-r >= 50) and the rock bank above the rim; the white foam lines, the stern-post tie and teal gap at the upper right stay in the terrain, and the dock post (x >= 681) is excluded.

Boat plate: the 10103 hull px hold inferred water made by mirror-copying same-image pond pixels (within 12px of the hull; the 3px next to the outline may mirror bank rock/foam/post outline so a 2px bob reveals the neighbouring surface, deeper pixels use water only so the interior stays calm water with the ripple/foam lines carried across). Outside the hull the plate is the reference, an envelope of 3px.
